documents.title: Customer incident description (email)
documents.text:
From: rohan.m.pune@mailbox.example
To: claims@nimbusgeneral.example
Subject: Claim intimation - accident on 10th Jan - policy NMS-2W-104822

Hello,

I want to report an accident with my bike (Splendor, MH12QT4431). On the evening of 10th Jan 2026, around 8-8:15 pm, I was riding home on Karve Road near Nal Stop. An auto rickshaw in front of me stopped suddenly, I braked hard and the front wheel slipped on some gravel and the bike went into the road divider.

I was wearing a helmet and I am fine, just a small bruise. Nobody else was involved or hurt. The front of the bike is damaged - mudguard, headlight and the handle got bent, and the fork also seems out of alignment.

I took the bike to Shree Sai Auto Works in Kothrud on Sunday (12th) and they have given an estimate of Rs 8,450 which I am attaching along with the claim form.

Please let me know if anything else is needed.

Thanks,
Rohan Malhotra
98xxxxx214
